output.reason: The release note and PR [ev-c54ac338953d][ev-6179140006bb] say only that `UseDomainQualifiedFinalizer` was promoted to Beta. They don't say whether its default changed. By contrast, the neighbouring NameConstraints note says "enabled by default" outright [ev-619c0cea3aa4]. The PR touches features.go and the chart's values.yaml/schema [ev-fe5209e3501f], so the default may have flipped, but the excerpts don't show the diff. The proposed exposure (gate enabled) only catches environments that already turned the gate on in Alpha, where nothing changes. If the default flipped, the exposed environments would instead be those that leave the gate unset. To decide, we need the features.go diff (the gate's Default/PreRelease values) and a statement of what changes in behaviour when the finalizer is domain-qualified.
